scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh
Family must not be covered under the Ayushman Bharat (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) scheme
Applicant must be a HIMCARE card holder
Scheme is open to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families as well as Above Poverty Line (APL) families
Senior citizens (including those above 70 years) are eligible
Daily wage earners, widows, and single women are eligible
MNREGA workers who have worked at least 50 days in the previous or current financial year are eligible
Children living in orphanages are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per year per family at empanelled hospitals.
